t: You're looking at numbers 11 to 15 Lower Grosvenor Place, a building in Westminster. It was designed by Thomas Cundy, who lived from 1790 to 1867. Cundy was an English architect who followed his father, also called Thomas, as surveyor of the Grosvenor Estate. He held that post during the main phase of the development of Belgravia and Pimlico, when the contractor Thomas Cubitt was building. So this stretch of street belongs to the great estate-led building of the area around you.
